rules.strength: strictly higher season PPG AND last-five PPG
rules.shooting: home/away venue shot proxy favours home
rules.timing: recorded starters assumed available at lineup time; history >24h before kickoff
rules.benchmark_universe: same home starters and team-history eligibility; no strength/shooting filter

plan.selection_reason: Unused full-season-shaped league dataset selected from coverage before player events; one expected fixture is absent and will remain explicitly missing.
plan.pattern_A: Existing frozen original environment-first 2+ shots rule.
plan.pattern_B: Pattern A plus previous-five-start average shots >=3 and average minutes >=80.

betting_policy.rollover_method: Sort selections by kickoff, fixture ID and player ID; partition into consecutive non-overlapping blocks of the stated length. Start each block with $10 and roll the entire return through every leg. Any loss returns $0. Ignore and count an incomplete final block.
betting_policy.same_kickoff_warning: The deterministic ordering can put simultaneous selections in one block, so rollover output is a mathematical selection-order simulation, not a claim that every block was executable live.

plan.decision_policy: No threshold, odds, rollover length, ordering or exclusion changes after player-event acquisition. Preserve all samples and losing blocks.
limits: One expected league fixture is absent; missing data will not be invented.

method_correction.reason: User clarified that rollover means one continuous all-in balance: $10 multiplied by odds for every consecutive win, with the entire accumulated balance lost on the next miss.
method_correction.restart_policy: For season-wide reporting, a new $10 is deposited after each loss to show the next independent streak. Without a new deposit, the first loss ends the simulation at $0.
method_correction.status: post-result accounting clarification; selection rules, odds, picks and outcomes unchanged
method_correction.warning: No profit is realized unless the bettor cashes out. Rolling the full balance into a losing next selection makes that streak's ending balance $0.
